seatingCopy.sub: RM 214 · 5TH PERIOD · 6 MINUTES BEFORE THE BELL
intro: Fourth period just left. These are the desks the way that class left them — you have not rearranged anything since, and this class has never sat in any of it.
Drag a name onto another name to swap them. The room is drawn from above; the whiteboard is at the top, same as it ever is.
The cabinet and the bookshelf still drag, too, and they remember exactly where fourth period put them.
